primaryMetrics.characterErrorRate: levenshtein(whitespaceFree(hypothesis), whitespaceFree(truth)) / whitespaceFree(truth).length; 1 when the truth is empty

usefulTokenRecall.matchRule: token is counted as matched when whitespaceFree(hypothesis).includes(token)
usefulTokenRecall.value: matchedTokens / totalTokens, or null when totalTokens is 0

primaryMetrics.deterministicRepeat: primary and repeat agree; see the determinism rule below
primaryMetrics.runtimeFailure: the invocation raised, timed out, or produced no output

secondaryMetrics.boundarySensitiveCharacterErrorRate: levenshtein(boundaryPreserving(hypothesis), boundaryPreserving(truth)) / boundaryPreserving(truth).length; 1 when the truth is empty
secondaryMetrics.whitespaceDifference: "none" when the two whitespace counts are equal, otherwise "hypothesis has N space(s), truth has M"
secondaryMetrics.punctuationDifferences: the multiset difference of non-alphanumeric, non-whitespace characters between hypothesis and truth, reported per item

multipleTruthStringsRule.rule: When an item carries more than one acceptable Brand truth string, metrics are computed against each and the best is retained. Better means: a whitespace-free exact match beats a non-match; otherwise the lower whitespace-free CER wins.

determinismRule.armB: For each item, the primary and the repeat must agree byte-for-byte on the raw probability tensor file, and must agree on the argmax token sequence, the collapsed token sequence, the raw transcript and the output fingerprint.
determinismRule.armA: Carried forward. PR #214 recorded a deterministic fingerprint for each Arm A primary/repeat pair; the carry-forward re-verifies the recorded hashes rather than re-running Tesseract.
determinismRule.nondeterminismConsequence: Any Arm B nondeterminism classifies that item PPOCRV6_NONDETERMINISTIC and blocks a KEEP decision.

gainedWhenAnyOf: Arm A is not a whitespace-free exact match and Arm B is
truth is not contiguous in Arm A's whitespace-free output and is in Arm B's
lostWhenAnyOf: Arm A is a whitespace-free exact match and Arm B is not
truth is contiguous in Arm A's whitespace-free output and is not in Arm B's
materialImprovementDefinition.equallyWrongRule: A change between two equally wrong transcripts is PPOCRV6_NO_EFFECT unless one has an objectively worse primary CER.

classificationPrecedence: PPOCRV6_NONDETERMINISTIC when the Arm B repeat does not match
PPOCRV6_INCOMPARABLE when a runtime failure prevents comparison
aggregationRule: No averaging may conceal an item-level material regression. Item-level classifications are always published in full alongside any cluster-level summary.
